system.description:
Those who witness you often swear you must have teleported, for you move faster than most conscious minds can think.

You may make five extra challenges when employing Velocity. Otherwise this power is identical to Swiftness, including its cost in Blood Traits. If used to cut travel time, the time is reduced to one thirty-second. Celerity draws no retest from any Ability, though the actions performed under it may be retested normally.
